title: Dwight Christmas
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office staff debates whether to hold a Christmas party and what kind it should be, with Dwight proposing an authentic Pennsylvania Dutch Christmas featuring traditional elements like gluhwein, hog maw, and the figure Belsnickel. Despite initial objections, the party planning committee supports Dwight's idea. Dwight leads the party with a Belsnickel gift-giving ceremony, judging coworkers as impish or admirable, and insists on breaking a ceremonial pig rib. Jim prepares to leave early for his new job in Philadelphia, sharing a heartfelt goodbye with Pam. The episode also includes side interactions such as Toby's jury experience with the Scranton Strangler case and Nellie kissing Toby, leaving some outcomes uncertain.
